about: Cross-attention of the text decoder of BLIP (Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-base, BSD-3-Clause), computed offline on four photos of the shark chapters. Tiles are 24 by 24 weights over patch tokens, averaged over the 12 heads of a layer.

sets.text: a shark swimming in the ocean
a hammerhead shark with a tall fin in blue water
a small fish in a tank with a rope
a brown shark on white sand by a rock
a shark is hanging on the wall
a small shark on a white board with a ruler
a green turtle on the beach
a pale turtle on dark wet sand
